text_en: Now Elisha had said to the woman whose son he had restored to life, “Get up and go with your household, and settle wherever you can; for the Lord has called for a famine, and it will come on the land for seven years. ”
text_cn: 厄里叟对自己曾复活其子的妇人说：“你和你的家人，应动身往你能居住的地方去侨居，因为上主已决定，这地快要遭受七年饥荒。”

text_en: So the woman got up and did according to the word of the man of God; she went with her household and settled in the land of the Philistines seven years.
text_cn: 那妇人就立即照天主的人所说的话作了；她和她的家人动身走了，在培肋舍特人的地方，侨居了七年。

text_en: At the end of the seven years, when the woman returned from the land of the Philistines, she set out to appeal to the king for her house and her land.
text_cn: 过了七年，这妇人从培肋舍特地方回来，便去求君王，要收回自己的房产和田地。

text_en: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Tell me all the great things that Elisha has done. ”
text_cn: 那时，君王正与天主的人的仆人革哈齐谈话，说：“请你将厄里叟所作的一切大事，讲给我听！”

text_en: While he was telling the king how Elisha had restored a dead person to life, the woman whose son he had restored to life appealed to the king for her house and her land. Gehazi said, “My lord king, here is the woman, and here is her son whom Elisha restored to life. ”
text_cn: 当革哈齐正向君王讲述先知如何复活死人的时候，恰好厄里叟曾复活其子的那妇人，前来求君王，要收回自己的房产和田地，革哈齐就说：“我主，大王！这就是那妇人，这就是厄里叟所复活的那儿子。”

text_en: When the king questioned the woman, she told him. So the king appointed an official for her, saying, “Restore all that was hers, together with all the revenue of the fields from the day that she left the land until now. ”
text_cn: 君王问那妇人，妇人便将那件事告诉了君王；君王于是将她的事，委托给一个宦官，吩咐他说：“凡这妇人的一切，和自从她离开此地直到今日，田地里的一切出产，都应归还给她。”

text_en: Elisha went to Damascus while King Ben-hadad of Aram was ill. When it was told him, “The man of God has come here, ”
text_cn: 厄里叟来到大马士革时，阿兰王本哈达得正在患病，有人告诉君王说：“天主的人到这里来了。”

text_en: the king said to Hazael, “Take a present with you and go to meet the man of God. Inquire of the Lord through him, whether I shall recover from this illness. ”
text_cn: 君王对哈匝耳说：“你随身带些礼物，去拜见天主的人，托他求问上主，我这病还能好吗？”

text_en: So Hazael went to meet him, taking a present with him, all kinds of goods of Damascus, forty camel loads. When he entered and stood before him, he said, “Your son King Ben-hadad of Aram has sent me to you, saying, ‘Shall I recover from this illness? ’”
text_cn: 哈匝耳就带了四十匹骆驼，满载着大马士革出产的上等礼品，前去拜见先知；到了以后，就站在先知面前说：“你的弟子阿兰王本哈达得打发我来问你：我这病还能好吗？”

text_en: Elisha said to him, “Go, say to him, ‘You shall certainly recover’; but the Lord has shown me that he shall certainly die. ”
text_cn: 厄里叟对他说：“你去告诉他：一定会好；但上主指示我：他一定要死。”

text_en: He fixed his gaze and stared at him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.
text_cn: 厄里叟定睛凝视哈匝耳，直使哈匝耳感到惭愧。这时天主的人就哭了。

text_en: Hazael asked, “Why does my lord weep? ” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the people of Israel; you will set their fortresses on fire, you will kill their young men with the sword, dash in pieces their little ones, and rip up their pregnant women. ”
text_cn: 哈匝耳问说：“我主，你为什么哭？”先知回答说：“因为我已知道你将要加于以色列子民的恶行：你要放火焚毁他们的堡垒，用刀杀死他们的青年，摔死他们的儿童，剖开他们的孕妇。”

text_en: Hazael said, “What is your servant, who is a mere dog, that he should do this great thing? ” Elisha answered, “The Lord has shown me that you are to be king over Aram. ”
text_cn: 哈匝耳说：“你的仆人算什么？只不过是一条狗，他如何能作出这样的大事？”厄里叟回答说：“上主已指示给我，你要作阿兰王。”

text_en: Then he left Elisha, and went to his master Ben-hadad, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you? ” And he answered, “He told me that you would certainly recover. ”
text_cn: 哈匝耳就离开厄里叟，回去见他的主上；君王问他说：“厄里叟对你说了些什么？”他回答说：“他告诉我：你一定会好。”

text_en: But the next day he took the bed-cover and dipped it in water and spread it over the king’s face, until he died. And Hazael succeeded him.
text_cn: 到了第二天，哈匝耳拿了被衾浸(qīn jìn)在水中，蒙在君王的脸上，君王就这样死了；哈匝耳就篡位为王。

text_en: In the fifth year of King Joram son of Ahab of Israel, Jehoram son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah began to reign.
text_cn: 以色列王阿哈布的儿子耶曷兰五年，犹大王约沙法特的儿子约兰登极为犹大王。

text_en: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 他即位时年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷为王八年。

text_en: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for the daughter of Ahab was his wife. He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord .
text_cn: 他走了以色列王所走的道路，像阿哈布家所行的一样，因为他娶了阿哈布的女儿为妻，行了上主视为恶的事。

text_en: Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah, for the sake of his servant David, since he had promised to give a lamp to him and to his descendants forever.
text_cn: 但是，上主为了他仆人达味的缘故，不愿消灭犹大，因为他曾向达味应许过，他的子孙中，要永远给他留下一盏明灯。

text_en: In his days Edom revolted against the rule of Judah, and set up a king of their own.
text_cn: 约兰年间，厄东人脱离了犹大的统治，自立为王；

text_en: Then Joram crossed over to Zair with all his chariots. He set out by night and attacked the Edomites and their chariot commanders who had surrounded him; but his army fled home.
text_cn: 那时，约兰率领自己所有的战车，到了匝依尔，乘夜间起来，冲出了包围他和那些战车长的厄东人，军民才得逃回自己的帐幕，

text_en: So Edom has been in revolt against the rule of Judah to this day. Libnah also revolted at the same time.
text_cn: 这样，厄东脱离了犹大的统治，直到今日。同时，里贝纳也背叛了犹大。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?
text_cn: 约兰其余的事迹，他的一切作为，都记载在《犹大列王实录》上。

text_en: So Joram slept with his ancestors, and was buried with them in the city of David; his son Ahaziah succeeded him.
text_cn: 约兰与列祖同眠后，与他的列祖葬在达味城；他的儿子阿哈齐雅继位为王。

text_en: In the twelfth year of King Joram son of Ahab of Israel, Ahaziah son of King Jehoram of Judah began to reign.
text_cn: 以色列王阿哈布的儿子耶曷兰十二年，犹大王约兰的儿子阿哈齐雅登极为王。

text_en: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri of Israel.
text_cn: 他即位时，年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王一年。他的母亲名叫阿塔里雅，是以色列王敖默黎的孙女。

text_en: He also walked in the way of the house of Ahab, doing what was evil in the sight of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done, for he was son-in-law to the house of Ahab.
text_cn: 阿哈齐雅走了阿哈布家的道路，行了上主视为恶的事，同阿哈布家一样，因为他是阿哈布家的女婿。

text_en: He went with Joram son of Ahab to wage war against King Hazael of Aram at Ramoth-gilead, where the Arameans wounded Joram.
text_cn: 他同阿哈布的儿子耶曷兰往辣摩特基肋阿得去，与阿兰王哈匝耳交战。阿兰人击伤了耶曷兰，

text_en: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds that the Arameans had inflicted on him at Ramah, when he fought against King Hazael of Aram. King Ahaziah son of Jehoram of Judah went down to see Joram son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was wounded.
text_cn: 耶曷兰就回到依次勒耳，治疗他在辣摩特与阿兰人交战时所受的伤。犹大王约兰的儿子阿哈齐雅，由于阿哈布的儿子耶曷兰患病，就下到依次勒耳去探望他。
